title: Learning Human-like Representations to Enable Learning Human Values
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on learning general human values such as morality, ethics, fairness, honesty, and compassion from human judgments on textual descriptions of actions.
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion, so there are no related findings.
